Maya (People Ops): Need a one-line manager paste for goal check-ins that teams can copy into 1:1s. Tiny please.
Owen L: Keep it to 6 lines per goal.
Tara S: Include: goal, metric, next actions, confidence, blockers, ask.
Maya (People Ops): Draft below. React with :+1: if good.
Maya (People Ops): ```
Goal (one line + metric)
Why: 1 sentence impact
This sprint: 2 actions (owner + ETA)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers (owner + ETA)
Manager ask: specific support
Feedback: Evidence -> Impact -> Next step (script: "When X happened, Y occurred; try Z next time.")
```
FeedbackBot: Tip: paste into calendar notes and pre-fill before the 1:1.
Owen L: Good to ship. I'll pilot and send notes.
Tara S: Thanks Maya!
